text:
megan: Opening a short PR: add a "quick troubleshooting" subsection to Dedicated provisioning for eviction and autoscale oddities + a tiny Java SDK example for creating reserved pools. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021

igor: Nice. Can you paste the Java snippet here so I can sanity check API names?

megan: sure, minimal snippet: ```java
RedwoodClient client = RedwoodClient.builder().build();
CreateReservedPoolRequest req = CreateReservedPoolRequest.builder()
  .name("reserved-nyc-3")
  .gpus(6)
  .labels(Map.of("pool","reserved-nyc-3","team","search"))
  .scalePolicy(ScalePolicy.builder().minReplicas(1).maxReplicas(12).cooldownSeconds(90).burstCapacity(2).build())
  .evictionPolicy("soft")
  .gracePeriodSeconds(300)
  .build();
client.createReservedPool(req);
```

paul: API looks fine. Small nit: in Java builder we use `gracePeriodSeconds` only for soft eviction; please add a comment in the snippet. Also prefer `evictionPolicy(EvictionPolicy.SOFT)` where possible so enums are used.

megan: updated snippet in PR to use enum and added comment about grace period. Also included a 1-line YAML sample and a CLI example per docs style. YAML: ```yaml
reserved_pool:
  name: reserved-nyc-3
  gpus: 6
  labels:
    pool: reserved-nyc-3
    team: search
  scale_policy:
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 12
    cooldown_seconds: 90
    burst_capacity: 2
  eviction_policy: soft  # grace_period_seconds honored
  grace_period_seconds: 300
```

megan: CLI: `rctl capacity create --name reserved-nyc-3 --gpus 6 --labels pool=reserved-nyc-3,team=search --scale-policy '{"minReplicas":1,"maxReplicas":12,"cooldownSeconds":90,"burstCapacity":2}' --eviction-policy soft --grace-period 300`

anya: Love the troubleshooting section idea. Could you add a compact checklist: selector mismatch, exhausted burst_capacity, cooldown window too long, or insufficient quota? Those are the top hits in support tickets.

megan: Added a 4-item checklist to PR. Also a tiny paragraph clarifying `burst_capacity` is expressed in GPU units and `cooldown_seconds` is the evaluation cooldown, not a hard delay.

igor: Please also add a one-liner clarifying model fallback order somewhere near the example: pinned -> quantized-compatible -> smaller-family. Customers keep asking about that.

megan: Done. Added `fallback_order` YAML example and a note that customers can override via tenant config. YAML snippet added: ```yaml
tenant:
  name: search-team
  selector: pool=reserved-nyc-3,team=search
  fallback_order: [pinned_version, quantized_8bit, smaller_model_family]
```

kevin: docs-bot flagged a link to `/dedicated/old-eviction` in the PR copy. Should be `/dedicated/eviction-policy`.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: 1 broken link detected: `/dedicated/old-eviction` -> suggested replacement `/dedicated/eviction-policy`. Automated patch created on branch.

paul: tiny wording nit: avoid the phrase "SLA" in the examples; use `service_level_target` instead for user-facing examples. Also swap any "best-effort" to "service-level target" language.

megan: Updated wording to `service_level_target` and replaced best-effort phrasing. Also added a short note: `grace_period_seconds` applies only to `soft` eviction; `hard` eviction preempts immediately.

anya: Can you add one troubleshooting example: what to check if a tenant never scales beyond min_replicas despite traffic? Quick list: verify selector labels, check reserved pool gpus vs burst_capacity, inspect cooldown_seconds/eval windows, confirm no manual cap in tenant config.

megan: Added that bullet list. Also included a short example of a mis-escaped label value causing selector mismatch and how to quote it in CLI. CLI example: `--labels "owner=team-\"search,rank\",pool=reserved-nyc-3"` with a note to prefer safe label keys.

kevin: Approving content once the docs-bot linkcheck is green and Java snippet uses enum.

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck fixed by automated patch, lint passed, static build OK.

igor: Reviewed the Java snippet and small nits addressed. Approving from platform.

paul: Approving from docs. :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: PR merged into main. Staged deploy succeeded.

megan: Merged. Release note: added Java SDK example, YAML + CLI examples, troubleshooting checklist for eviction/autoscale, clarified fallback order and eviction semantics. Will backport trimmed advisory to 1.x handbook. Thanks all! :tada:
